sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-157.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 157 was established by Ordinance No. 17940, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 3, 1983. Ordinance No. 17940 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17940 was amended by Ordinance No. 20490, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 25, 1989, and Ordinance No. 24115, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 1999. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17940; 20490; 24115; 25508; 30506)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-157.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 157 is established on property generally located at the east corner of Oak Lawn Avenue and Cedar Springs Road. The size of PD 157 is approximately 3.13 acres. (Ord. Nos. 17940; 25508; 30506)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51.
(c)This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 25508; 30506) SEC. 51P-157.103.1.EXHIBIT. The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 157A: development/landscape plan. (Ord. 30506)

sections.title: Development/Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-157.104.DEVELOPMENT/LANDSCAPE PLAN. Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 157A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.105.MAIN USES PERMITTED.
(a)The following main uses are the only main uses permitted: --retail/bar/restaurant uses [limited to 89,304 square feet]; --athletic club facilities; --office uses; --residential and accessory uses [minimum 80,000 square feet];
(b)Total nonresidential development may not exceed 397,738 square feet for a maximum nonresidential floor area ratio of 2.91 to 1.
(c)Development on stories 12 through 19 is limited to residential uses. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506) SEC. 51P-157.105.1.ACCESSORY USES. As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51-4.217. (Ord. 30506)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.106.YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS. (Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51-4.400, this section controls.)
(a)Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations are governed by the development/landscape plan.
(b)Maximum structure height is 268 feet, 6 inches. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.107.OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.
(a)A minimum of 1,183 spaces are required for this development. An additional 51 spaces must be provided by this development for the use of the Argyle Apartments (labeled as “Ardmore II the Argyle LLC” on the development/landscape plan).
(b)Head in angled parking is allowed as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-157.108.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of a building permit, a subdivision plat as approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk. The subdivision plat must show all right-of-way dedications required by the Traffic Management Plan as approved by the department of mobility and street services. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.109.SIGNS.
(a)Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII.
(b)The freestanding tower element labeled on the development/landscape plan that is attached to the below grade garage is considered attached for purposes of signage.
(c)For attached signs, secondary facades may also be considered primary facades.
(d)Digital display premise signs may exceed the effective area limitation only if the digital display sign displays tenant or building identification signage one in every six change of messages with the other change of messages being art images. Digital display premise signs are limited to a maximum of five percent of the facade on the east corner of Cedar Springs Road and Oak Lawn Avenue. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506) SEC. 51P-157.109.1.ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS. See Article VI. (Ord. 30506)

sections.title: Screening And Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.110.SCREENING AND LANDSCAPING.
(a)Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan.
(b)The director of mobility and street services shall approve the location of all landscape material within the street right-of-way prior to planting.
(c)The director of parks and recreation must approve a maintenance agreement for maintaining all landscape material within the street right-of-way prior to any planting.
(d)Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.
(e)Two trees are permitted in the visibility triangle at the corner of Welborn Street and Hall Street, as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.111.ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.
(a)The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.
(b)Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 26102; 30506)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-157.112.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.
(a)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.
(b)The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24115; 25508; 30506)
